about_the_game:
Island Beekeeper

Become the savior of humanity in the skies!

Earth is on the brink of destruction: diseases, famine and the decline of nature have engulfed the world. The only hope is the unique honey from floating sky islands, capable of healing, nourishing and extending life. You are the chosen beekeeper, sent to these mysterious islands to harvest the precious resource and send it to the survivors below. But remember: others before you... and none returned. Why? Unravel the mystery before the buzzing of bees falls silent forever.

Island Beekeeper — is a cozy beekeeping simulation with elements of exploration, crafting and survival in an atmospheric world of floating islands. Build and upgrade your base, breed exotic bees, grow rare plants and experiment with alchemy and cooking. Every day is a cycle of productive tranquility: from collecting honey to sending shipments to Earth. But the world reacts to your actions — the stability of humanity depends on you!

Key features

🗺️Exploration of sky islands

Fly on mechanical wings between biomes — from the cozy main island with your home to the dense forest full of secrets and resources. Collect seeds, mushrooms and pollen, find traces of missing beekeepers.

🐝Bee breeding and hybridization

Tame wild bees of different species — forest, rain, ice. Cross them in mini-puzzles to create hybrids with unique properties. Clean hives from parasites in engaging mini-games to maintain honey quality.

🧪Crafting and alchemy

Brew elixirs and tinctures at the alchemy table to modify bees, create temporary potions and influence hives. Solve mini-puzzles with temperature and ingredient sequences for perfect results.

🍳Cooking and gardening

Prepare dishes and drinks from honey, fruits and mushrooms — mead for speed buffs, pies for inventory expansion. Grow beds with rare plants in the greenhouse, create bouquet lures and affect harvest quality.

📡Connection to Earth and stability

Receive emotional letters from survivors, complete tasks and send honey on time. High stability brings gifts, unique traders on airships and a blooming world. Miss a shipment — and the consequences will be felt.

🧘Meditative gameplay cycle

Between expeditions, enjoy micro-tasks — water the bed, experiment with recipes, repair the hive. Morning on the apiary: collect honey, brew a pie, receive a letter and meet a trader — all in a calm rhythm.

Why Island Beekeeper?

It's not just a farm — it's a story of hope, mysteries and connection to the world. Relaxing gameplay with adventure elements: fly between islands, solve puzzles of the past and save humanity one hive at a time.
